observations: Photo 0 and photo 1 show the same single blue plastic drum standing on dirt ground, other blue drums and a blue jerrycan behind it.
It is a closed-top drum with two white screw bungs on the top.
The top has been cut across and fitted with three small rusty metal hinges, so half the top opens as a flap lid; this is a modification, not factory.
The body is scuffed and scratched, with green paint marks on the top and side; clearly used.
A moulded 'this way up' arrow mark is visible on the side; no brand, capacity or contents label is legible.
Watermark 'SAIVET NIGERIA ENTERPRISE' and 'Posted on Jiji' on both photos, so these are a dealer's advert photos.
Size looks like the common large drum but there is nothing in shot to judge scale.

identity.kind: used blue plastic drum, closed top with cut hinged lid

claims.evidence: Photo 0 and photo 1 show a scuffed, paint-marked drum with a home-made hinged cut lid and rusty hinges; quality is not shown and the general statement proves nothing.

risks.proof: A photo looking inside through the open flap with a torch, plus any label showing what it held
risks.if_unproven: as a used drum fit only for non-potable storage

risks.risk: The cut top and hinges may leak or let in dirt, and the cut edge may crack
risks.proof: A close up of the cut line and hinges with the flap open and closed
risks.if_unproven: as a modified drum that does not seal

risks.risk: Cracks or holes in the body or base
risks.proof: A clip of the drum filled with water standing for a few minutes, showing the base
risks.if_unproven: as a used drum with possible leaks

risks.proof: A photo of the drum beside a measuring tape, or the capacity moulded on the base
risks.if_unproven: as the smaller common drum size

risks.risk: Dealer stock photo, may not be the exact drum delivered
risks.proof: A photo of the drum being sold with a handwritten note of today's date
risks.if_unproven: as one used modified drum, inspected before payment

proof_requests: A photo inside the drum through the open flap with a torch, and any label showing previous contents
A clip of the drum filled with water showing no leak at the base or the cut lid
A close up of the hinges and cut line with the flap open
A photo of the drum beside a measuring tape or the moulded capacity mark

response.reason: The item is plainly a used blue plastic drum with a cut hinged lid, identified by type, so it can be priced at worst case as a used, modified, non-potable drum. Previous contents, leaks and size stay as conditions until proven.
